translations.english: I enjoy doing interesting things with my friends.
translations.japanese: 友達と面白いことをするのが好きです。
translations.notes: English 'enjoy doing' = Japanese 'verb-のが好き'. The verb nominalizer の converts the action to a noun.

translations.english: He wanted to write a letter to his friend last week.
translations.japanese: 彼は先週、友達に手紙を書きたかったです。
translations.notes: Past tense of 'want to V' = verb stem + たかった. Single conjugated form in Japanese vs two-word English pattern.

translations.english: She wanted to put his letter in her bag.
translations.japanese: 彼女は彼の手紙をバッグに入れたかったです。
translations.notes: 'put' = 入れる (ireru). Pattern: verb stem + たかった for past desire.

translations.english: We wanted to give you a little more time.
translations.japanese: 私たちはもう少し時間をあげたかったです。
translations.notes: 'give (to you)' = あげる. Humble/polite giving.

translations.english: I don't enjoy waking up when I didn't sleep very well.
translations.japanese: よく眠れなかった時に起きるのは好きじゃないです。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 起きるのは好きじゃない
translations.notes: Negative of 'enjoy doing' = verb-のは好きじゃない. 眠れなかった = couldn't sleep (potential negative past).

translations.english: So I can remember how to say a few words.
translations.japanese: だから、いくつかの言葉の言い方を覚えられます。
translations.notes: 'how to say' = 言い方 (noun form). Japanese nominalizes 'how to V' as V方 (かた).

translations.english: I can't recall how to say what I wanted to say.
translations.english_canonical: I can't remember how to say what I wanted to say.
translations.japanese: 言いたかったことの言い方を思い出せません。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 言い方を思い出せない
translations.notes: JPN_FOR_ENG: Changed 'remember' to 'recall' to disambiguate from seed 56's 覚える. 思い出す = retrieve forgotten info. ZUT FIX.

translations.english: It's interesting when you understand enough words.
translations.japanese: 十分な言葉が分かると面白いです。
translations.notes: No verbal collocation. 分かる = understand/know. と conditional = 'when/if'.

translations.english: I know how to do what I need to do next week.
translations.japanese: 来週やらなければならないことのやり方を知っています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: やらなければならない
translations.notes: 'need to V' = Vなければならない (must). 'how to do' = やり方. やる is casual for する.

translations.english: I don't know how to say enough different words yet.
translations.japanese: まだ十分な違う言葉の言い方を知りません。
translations.notes: Negative: 知りません. まだ = yet/still.

translations.english: Could you say that again a little more slowly?
translations.japanese: もう少しゆっくり、もう一度言っていただけますか？
verbal_collocations_japanese: 言っていただけますか
translations.notes: Polite request: Vていただけますか. Very polite form for 'could you V'.

translations.english: I'm not sure if I can help you at the same time.
translations.japanese: 同時にあなたを手伝えるかどうか分かりません。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 手伝えるかどうか分からない
translations.notes: 'not sure if' = かどうか分からない. 手伝える = potential of 手伝う.

translations.english: Are you sure you don't mind helping me?
translations.japanese: 本当に手伝っても構いませんか？
translations.notes: 'don't mind V-ing' = Vても構わない. 構いません = don't mind (polite).

translations.english: Learning Japanese isn't easy but it is fun.
translations.japanese: 日本語を学ぶのは簡単じゃないですけど、楽しいです。
translations.notes: Replaced 'Spanish' with '日本語'. 学ぶのは = learning (nominalized). けど = but (casual).

translations.english: It's important to take time to test yourself.
translations.japanese: 時間をかけて自分をテストすることが大切です。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 時間をかけてテストする
translations.notes: 'take time' = 時間をかける. 'It's important to V' = Vことが大切.

translations.english: It's not difficult to find the answer.
translations.japanese: 答えを見つけるのは難しくないです。
translations.notes: 'It's not difficult to V' = Vのは難しくない. 見つける = find.

translations.english: Why do you want to stop?
translations.japanese: どうして止めたいですか？
translations.notes: 'want to V' = V stem + たい. どうして = why.

translations.english: He didn't want to look after the young dog all afternoon.
translations.japanese: 彼は午後ずっと若い犬の世話をしたくなかったです。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 世話をしたくなかった
translations.notes: 'look after' = 世話をする (take care of). Past negative desire: Vたくなかった.

translations.english: She didn't want to tell me where it was.
translations.japanese: 彼女はそれがどこにあったか教えたくなかったです。
translations.notes: 'tell' = 教える. Embedded question: どこにあったか.

translations.english: We didn't want to let anyone hear the truth.
translations.japanese: 私たちは誰にも本当のことを聞かせたくなかったです。
translations.notes: 'let someone hear' = 聞かせる (causative of 聞く). Japanese merges 'let hear' into one causative verb.

translations.english: I think that you're doing very well.
translations.japanese: あなたはとても上手にやっていると思います。
translations.notes: 'I think that...' = ...と思います. Present progressive: やっている.

translations.english: Thank you very much, but I've got more to learn.
translations.japanese: どうもありがとうございます。でも、まだ学ぶことがあります。
translations.notes: 'have more to learn' = 学ぶことがある (there is learning to do).

translations.english: Thank you very much for helping me to understand.
translations.japanese: 分かるように助けてくれてありがとうございます。
translations.notes: 'help to V' = Vように助ける. くれて = receiving action (from you to me).

translations.english: Have you got more to learn?
translations.japanese: まだ学ぶことがありますか？
translations.notes: Same pattern as 72. Question form with か.

translations.english: I'm very happy with how much I've learnt already.
translations.japanese: もう学んだことにとても満足しています。
translations.notes: 'happy with' = 満足している. 学んだこと = what I have learned.

translations.english: I'm surprised at how quickly I'm starting to understand.
translations.japanese: こんなに早く分かり始めていることに驚いています。
translations.notes: 'start to V' = V stem + 始める. Compound verb pattern. 驚いている = am surprised.

translations.english: I don't understand what you said.
translations.japanese: あなたが言ったことが分かりません。
translations.notes: 'what you said' = 言ったこと. Plain negative: 分かりません.

translations.english: When did you start to learn?
translations.japanese: いつ学び始めましたか？
translations.notes: 'start to V' = V stem + 始める. Compound verb in Japanese.

translations.english: I'm not sure when I'll be ready.
translations.japanese: いつ準備ができるか分かりません。
translations.notes: 'be ready' = 準備ができる. 'not sure when' = いつ...か分からない.

translations.english: When do you want to start?
translations.japanese: いつ始めたいですか？
translations.notes: 'want to V' = V stem + たい.

translations.english: I'm not going to wait for you. Why not?
translations.japanese: あなたを待たないつもりです。どうしてですか？
translations.notes: 'not going to V' = Vないつもり. Expresses intention not to do.

translations.english: I agree with what you said about your friend.
translations.japanese: あなたの友達について言ったことに賛成です。
translations.notes: 'agree with' = 賛成する. に marks the thing agreed with.

translations.english: I don't agree with what he said about my friend.
translations.japanese: 彼が私の友達について言ったことに賛成しません。
translations.notes: Negative: 賛成しません.

translations.english: I don't know those people.
translations.japanese: あの人たちを知りません。
translations.notes: Simple negative. 知りません = don't know.

translations.english: It wasn't possible, unfortunately.
translations.japanese: 残念ながら、できませんでした。
translations.notes: 'wasn't possible' = できなかった (past negative of potential). 残念ながら = unfortunately.

translations.english: They are people I don't know.
translations.japanese: 彼らは私が知らない人たちです。
translations.notes: Relative clause: 知らない人たち (people I don't know).

translations.english: I'm not ready to talk to people I don't know yet.
translations.japanese: まだ知らない人と話す準備ができていません。
translations.notes: 'ready to V' = Vする準備ができている. Nested relative clause.

translations.english: I think that I've done a lot in a short time.
translations.japanese: 短い時間でたくさんやったと思います。
translations.notes: Past: やった. と思います = I think that.

translations.english: If you can speak more slowly that would be great.
translations.japanese: もっとゆっくり話せたら、すごく助かります。
translations.notes: Conditional たら form: 話せたら (if you can speak). 助かります = would be helpful/great.

translations.english: It's difficult to think quickly enough to answer in time.
translations.japanese: 間に合うように答えるために十分速く考えるのは難しいです。
translations.notes: 'in order to V' = Vために. 間に合う = to be in time.

translations.english: I'd like to keep on doing this for a while.
translations.japanese: しばらくこれを続けたいです。
translations.notes: 'keep on doing' = 続ける. Japanese compresses to single verb. しばらく = for a while.

translations.english: It's time to go now.
translations.japanese: もう行く時間です。
translations.notes: 'time to V' = Vする時間.

translations.english: This is the only way it will work.
translations.japanese: これがうまくいく唯一の方法です。
translations.notes: 'will work' = うまくいく (go well). 唯一の = the only.

translations.english: Are you ready to go home on the next bus?
translations.japanese: 次のバスで家に帰る準備はできていますか？
verbal_collocations_japanese: 帰る準備ができている
translations.notes: 'ready to V' = Vする準備ができている. 帰る = go home.

translations.english: No I'm not ready yet, I need a little more time.
translations.japanese: いいえ、まだ準備ができていません。もう少し時間が必要です。
translations.notes: 'need' expressed as 必要です (is necessary). まだ = not yet.

translations.english: Yes I'm ready to go as soon as you want.
translations.japanese: はい、あなたが望む時にいつでも行く準備ができています。
verbal_collocations_japanese: 行く準備ができている
translations.notes: 'as soon as you want' = あなたが望む時にいつでも.

translations.english: I should consider playing something else.
translations.japanese: 他のものをプレイすることを考えるべきです。
verbal_collocations_japanese: プレイすることを考えるべき
translations.notes: 'should V' = Vするべき. 'consider V-ing' = Vすることを考える.

translations.english: You should ask yourself why it's not working.
translations.japanese: なぜうまくいかないのか自分に聞くべきです。
translations.notes: 'ask yourself' = 自分に聞く. Embedded question with のか.

translations.english: You shouldn't worry about doing something similar.
translations.japanese: 似たようなことをすることを心配するべきじゃないです。
verbal_collocations_japanese: することを心配するべきじゃない
translations.notes: Negative べき: べきじゃない. 'worry about V-ing' = Vすることを心配する.

translations.english: I'm enjoying finding out more about this language.
translations.japanese: この言語についてもっと知ることを楽しんでいます。
translations.notes: 'enjoy V-ing' = Vすることを楽しむ. Progressive: 楽しんでいます.

verb_inventory.want: たい (suffix attached to verb stem)
verb_inventory.don't enjoy: 好きじゃない / 楽しまない
verb_inventory.give: あげる (to others) / くれる (to me)
verb_inventory.need: 必要 (noun pattern) / なければならない

japanese_equivalents.want to V: V stem + たい (single conjugated form)
japanese_equivalents.enjoy V-ing: Vのが好き OR Vことを楽しむ
japanese_equivalents.ready to V: Vする準備ができている

master_key_analysis.description: Japanese patterns that cover multiple English constructions with fewer distinct forms

keys.cognitive_advantage: Single suffix system vs English modal + infinitive
Compound verb - one unit vs two-word English phrase

lower_in_japanese: Desire (たい) is a single suffix with regular conjugation
Compound verbs (始める, 続ける) merge aspect into verb
No gerund vs infinitive distinction to memorize
Potential form is suffix-based, not separate word
higher_in_japanese: Causative forms (させる, 聞かせる) require learning new verb forms
Direction-of-giving verbs (あげる vs くれる vs もらう)
Nominalization choice (こと vs の) has subtle differences
Embedded question markers (か, かどうか) require attention
form_consistency_notes: 学ぶ consistently used for 'learn' throughout
分かる consistently used for 'understand' throughout
知る/知っている used for 'know' (action vs state)
思う used for 'think' (opinion), 考える for 'consider/think about'
やる/する both used for 'do' - やる is more casual
